Author: Sadonia
Name: Eorzea Milkers (dev)
Punchline: Private dev build of Eorzea Milkers: its own save and its own server. Not for general use.
Description:
Private dev build of Eorzea Milkers, for trying new features before they reach testing.

It's a separate plugin with its own save, its own /milkersdev command and its own server, so nothing here touches live or testing. Enable only one of the two while you play.

Adults only (18+); Lalafell characters can't play.
